title: Advanced Manufacturing Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Additive manufacturing, process parameters, material constraints, and quality testing. The Advanced Manufacturing Database documents how things are made at the frontier: additive manufacturing (3D printing) processes with their parameters, material constraints, subtractive and formative methods, and the quality testing that proves a part is good. A printed part is not a part until it is tested — each record includes process parameters, material data, post-processing, and the test results (dimensional, mechanical, NDT) that qualify the part.

title: Advanced Manufacturing Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Processes: FDM (extrusion, cheap, anisotropic), SLA (resin, fine detail, brittle), SLS (powder nylon, no supports, porous), DMLS/SLM (metal powder, dense parts, residual stress), binder jetting (fast, needs sintering). Parameters: layer height (detail vs speed), infill (strength vs weight), orientation (anisotropy control), supports (removal cost), temperature (adhesion). Materials: polymers (PLA, ABS, nylon, PEEK), metals (Ti-6Al-4V, Inconel, AlSi10Mg), ceramics; each with printed properties (note: differ from bulk). Post-processing: support removal, heat treat (stress relief), HIP (metals, closes pores), machining critical surfaces. Quality: dimensional (CMM, scanning), mechanical (tensile, fatigue — orientation noted), NDT (CT for internal defects, ultrasound). DFM: min wall thickness, overhang angles, escape holes for powder.

demo.title: Execution: A* pathfinding on a grid
demo.code: const grid=[[0,0,0,1],[0,1,0,0],[0,0,0,0]];const W=4,H=3;function h(a,b){return Math.abs(a[0]-b[0])+Math.abs(a[1]-b[1]);}function astar(s,g){const open=[{p:s,f:h(s,g),c:0}],came={},cost={[s]:0};while(open.length){open.sort((a,b)=>a.f-b.f);const cur=open.shift();if(cur.p[0]===g[0]&&cur.p[1]===g[1]){const path=[g];let k=g+'';while(came[k]){path.unshift(came[k]);k=came[k]+'';}return path;}for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const n=[cur.p[0]+dx,cur.p[1]+dy];if(n[0]<0||n[1]<0||n[0]>=H||n[1]>=W||grid[n[0]][n[1]])continue;const nc=cur.c+1;if(cost[n+'']===undefined||nc<cost[n+'']){cost[n+'']=nc;came[n+'']=cur.p;open.push({p:n,f:nc+h(n,g),c:nc});}}}}const path=astar([0,0],[2,3]);J({steps:path.length-1});assert(path.length-1===5,'astar');

title: Advanced Manufacturing Database — Verification: tests and limitations
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Tests: selection test (requirements map to suitable processes); DFM test (known violations flagged); quality test (plans cover dimensional + mechanical); determinism test. Limitations: recommendations are guidance; real qualification needs physical testing; material data needs batch verification. Every record states its process+material+parameter basis.

demo.title: Execution: Hohmann transfer delta-v
demo.code: const mu=398600;function circ(r){return Math.sqrt(mu/r);}const r1=6678,r2=42164;const a=(r1+r2)/2;const dv1=Math.abs(Math.sqrt(mu*(2/r1-1/a))-circ(r1));const dv2=Math.abs(circ(r2)-Math.sqrt(mu*(2/r2-1/a)));J({dv1:+dv1.toFixed(2),dv2:+dv2.toFixed(2),total:+(dv1+dv2).toFixed(2)});assert(dv1+dv2>3.8&&dv1+dv2<4.0,'hohmann');
